sloka: सधनुस्त्वं हि लोकांस्त्रीन्विजयेथा न संशयः ।दिष्ट्या त्वया हतो राम रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।। ७.१.१९ ॥
transliteration: sadhanustvaṁ hi lokāṁstrīnvijayethā na saṁśayaḥ ।diṣṭyā tvayā hato rāma rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।। 7.1.19 ॥

translations.english: There is no doubt that you, with your bow, could indeed conquer the three worlds, and it is fortunate, O Rama, that you have slain Ravana, the lord of the Rakshasas.
